map.由初速与制动痕迹长度计算减速度与等效 g 值，或按路面附着系数推算理论制动距离。: Computes deceleration and equivalent g from initial speed and skid length, or derives theoretical braking distance from the road grip coefficient.
map.制动距离：车速 v(m/s) = V(km/h) ÷ 3.6；极限减速度 a_m: Braking distance: speed v(m/s) = V(km/h) ÷ 3.6; limit deceleration a_max = μ × g; limit stopping distance s = v² ÷ (2 × a_max); actual grip utilization = actual deceleration ÷ limit deceleration × 100%.

map.📐 制动距离与初速平方成正比: 📐 Braking Distance Scales with the Square of Speed
map.车速翻倍，制动距离约变 4 倍。因此高速行驶时必须按「车速平方」放大安全车距，而: Double the speed and stopping distance grows about fourfold, so at high speed you must enlarge the following distance by the "square of speed", not linearly.
map.现场测得制动痕迹长度 s 与路面 μ，即可反推碰撞前车速 v=√(2μgs)。实: With skid length s and surface μ measured on site, pre-impact speed follows as v=√(2μgs). Real reconstruction must discount the error in mark start/end points and consider ABS skid patterns.
map.💡 本工具计算的是「物理极限减速度」，未含驾驶员反应时间。实际停车总距离还应加上: 💡 This tool computes the "physical limit deceleration" and excludes driver reaction time. Total stopping distance must also add reaction distance (speed × reaction time).
map.交通事故还原时，按刹车痕迹长度与碰撞前车速估算制动减速度，判断驾驶员是否及时制动: In accident reconstruction, estimate deceleration from skid length and pre-impact speed to judge whether the driver braked in time.
map.对比不同轮胎与路面（干沥青、湿滑、冰雪）的减速度差异，理解安全车距。: Compare deceleration across tires and surfaces (dry asphalt, wet, ice and snow) to understand safe following distance.
map.车辆研发或教学中，由初速与制动距离反推等效 g 值，评估制动系统能力。: In vehicle development or teaching, derive equivalent g from initial speed and braking distance to evaluate brake capability.
map.由初速与距离求减速度: Deceleration from initial speed and distance
map.初速 v=27.8m/s（100km/h），干燥沥青完全制动距离 s=40m；匀: Initial speed v=27.8m/s (100km/h), full braking distance on dry asphalt s=40m; assuming constant deceleration a=v²/(2s)=27.8²/(2×40)≈9.66m/s², equivalent g = a/9.81 ≈ 0.98g, close to the dry-road tire grip limit of about 1.0g, showing braking was near the limit and road grip was fully exploited.
map.长这么多？: so much longer on snow and ice?
map.减速度上限由轮胎与路面附着系数 μ 决定（a≈μ·g）。干沥青 μ≈1.0、湿滑: The deceleration ceiling is set by the tire-road grip coefficient μ (a≈μ·g). Dry asphalt μ≈1.0, wet about 0.6, packed snow about 0.3, ice only 0.1; at the same initial speed braking distance is inversely proportional to μ, so on ice deceleration is about 1/10 of dry road and distance grows roughly tenfold.
map.ABS 防止车轮抱死、保持转向能力，在多数路面上能让减速度接近附着极限（接近无: ABS keeps wheels from locking and preserves steering, letting deceleration approach the grip limit on most surfaces (close to the best non-ABS result) and avoiding long locked-wheel slides; it does not shorten the physical limit distance, it only makes braking more stable and controllable.
map.结果为物理极限值，未含驾驶员反应时间，事故还原须结合现场实测: Results are physical limits and exclude driver reaction time; accident reconstruction must combine on-site measurements
